$comment: VERSIONED CONTENT, NOT CODE (hard rule 14; Carl, 3 Sep 2026 -- option lists are content). The ways a signer may ask for their own copy of a signed agreement, in the order the tablet offers them. W6, REQ-PORT-02 -- the s 65C copy-on-request obligation, automated. THE LIST IS THE SCREEN. A channel is added or withdrawn by editing this file: no code change, no deploy of new logic, and the `version` travels with every copy request made from it, so a record made in March still says what it was offered from. NO ADDRESS IS EVER TYPED ON THE TABLET (D-2026-09-11-03). Each option here is a channel TYPE only. The address it goes to is the one already on the record -- the patient's own when the patient signed, the assignor's own when somebody else did (ASSIGNOR-RULES rules 5-6) -- and it is shown to the patient partly masked so they can recognise it without it being readable across the room. An option whose contact is missing is not offered; the answer then is reception, never a text box. `not_now` IS A REAL OPTION AND NOT AN ABSENCE. A patient who wants no copy has said something, and a screen that only offers ways to say yes is not offering a choice. It sends nothing and records nothing beyond the ceremony ending. THE WORDS ARE NOT HERE. Display labels live in the string table keyed by `key` (REQ-LANG-01/-02), because they will be translated and a translated word must never be able to change which channel is used.

options.note: The signer's own email address, as held on the record. Carries a link to the signed PDF the portal already renders; never the document itself, and never an amount (hard rule 4).
The signer's own mobile, as held on the record. One line, the same link.
No copy. Sends nothing. The ceremony is already complete either way (hard rule 8) -- this option changes nothing about the agreement or the visit.
